usage contains input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, input_tokens_details.cached_tokens, and output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.

Session caching reports prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation_input_tokens, and prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens. Cache creation fields are absent when no new cache is created.

Each x_details entry with x_billing_type=response_api contains input_tokens, output_tokens, input_tokens_details.text_tokens, input_tokens_details.image_tokens, output_tokens_details.text_tokens, and output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.

The response.completed stream event carries response.usage. Tool counters include x_tools.web_search.count and x_tools.image_search.count.
